# Ellevux

> A one-person web studio. Websites designed and built by hand, then structured so
> search engines can rank them and AI assistants can quote them. Remote, worldwide,
> in English. Run by Yuvi.

## What the studio does

- **Websites.** Design and build, by hand. No page builders, no templates. From 2,000 USD.
- **SEO and AEO.** Technical search foundations plus answer engine optimization:
  a plain-text answer layer, real text in the HTML, and crawler policy set per vendor.
  Every method is graded by evidence strength and sourced at /ai-search/.
  AI visibility audit 600 USD. Included in a build from 9,000 USD.

## Pricing

- Launch, from 2,000 USD. One page, about one week.
- Flagship, from 4,500 USD. Up to six pages, about two to three weeks.
- Flagship + AI Search, from 9,000 USD. Six pages plus six answer pages, then ninety days.
- AI visibility audit, 600 USD flat, for a site that already exists.

Rankings and AI citations are never guaranteed, because nobody can control them.
